findings.title: Preserve or update the removed mark_failed helper API
findings.body: This extraction renames `mark_failed_threshold` to `try_incident_threshold` and removes it from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`; the same change removes the previously importable `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, and `get_monitor_environment_context` symbols from that module. Any existing callers, integrations, or tests importing these non-private helpers from their former path will now fail with ImportError/AttributeError rather than receiving a compatibility path. Update every consumer in the repository and/or leave forwarding aliases in `mark_failed.py` (ideally with a deprecation plan) before merging.
